Synopsis
The anime " Since the Red Moon " is adapted from a work of fiction of the same name written by Kuroyama Lao Gui. The story is about the sudden appearance of a blood-red moon in the sky, historically known as the Red Moon Incident. The remaining survivors had to hide in the city protected by high walls. Among the survivors, there are some people with mental mutations, in which the mental mutants who can't control themselves emit a mental plague, radiating and contaminating the normal people around them, posing a great threat to the surviving human beings. To solve the source of contamination, the high-walled city has set up a special contamination clean-up department to recruit people who can control their mental energies, and our protagonist Lu Xin is applying for the most dangerous clean-up department!
動畫《從紅月開始》改編自黑山老鬼創作的同名小說作品。故事講述了天空突然出現一輪血紅色的月亮，史稱紅月亮事件。剩下的倖存者們不得不躲進高牆保護的城市裡，而在倖存者之中，也有部分人出現了精神異變，其中無法控制自己的精神異變者，會散發出精神瘟疫，輻射汙染周圍的正常人，給倖存的人類造成極大的威脅，為了解決汙染源，高牆城成立特別汙染清理部門，招募可以控制精神能量，而我們主角陸辛正在應聘最危險的清理部門！
